blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Pop girl group BINI member Mikha Lim has apologized for using her cellphone while driving, calling her actions “careless and irresponsible” and vowing to be more mindful on the road. Lim posted the apology on her social media account on Wednesday evening, addressing the incident captured in a viral video. “There is absolutely no excuse for using my phone while behind the wheel,” she said. “I take full accountability for what happened.” She added that she had already reported to the LTO and was undergoing due process to face the appropriate penalties.
